title: Verify: Send disabled for blank, over-limit, zero-quota and in-flight unit tests
summary: Unit tests assert every disabled condition and fix existing tests that clicked a now-disabled Send.
description: New test file with mocked ../src/api/client (submitContribution, listMine) following the pattern in tests/contributionQuotaGate.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Send is disabled for blank, whitespace-only, over-limit and zero-quota states.
Send is disabled while a submission is pending and enabled for valid text with quota.

in_scope: Adapting blank/max-length tests that click a disabled Send

technical_constraints: Mock listMine and submitContribution with vi.mock; no network
definition_of_done: New tests pass; adapted existing tests pass

steps.action: Create the suite with the vi.mock block copied from tests/contributionQuotaGate.test.tsx. Tests: (1) listMine resolves [], no text -> Send disabled; (2) type '   ' -> disabled; (3) type 'x'.repeat(MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH+1) -> disabled; (4) listMine resolves historyOf(MAX_PER_PLAYER) using contributionFixture from tests/fixtures/api -> disabled with valid text; (5) type 'hello', submitMock returns a never-resolving promise, fireEvent.submit the form -> Send disabled; (6) type 'hello' with quota -> enabled.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionSubmitDisabled.test.tsx

steps.action: Replace fireEvent.click on the Send button with fireEvent.submit on the form element (screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Send'}).closest('form')) in tests that expect 'Enter an idea first', since Send is now disabled for blank text.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx
steps.expected: Blank tests still assert the inline message and zero submit calls.

steps.action: Where a test clicks Send with over-limit text, use fireEvent.submit on the form instead and keep the assertions that submitMock is not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionMaxLength.test.tsx
steps.expected: Over-limit tests pass against the disabled button.
